name: Campfire
description: Search, analyze, and retrieve data from your Campfire ERP directly in Claude. Ask questions about projects, contacts, and financials in natural language. Create board decks, generate insights from your data, and make informed decisions as a native part of your AI workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Campfire to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Campfire to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.meetcampfire.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Campfire MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Campfire provides these MCP tools: get_accounts, get_aging, get_budgets, get_contracts, get_departments, get_entities, get_tags, get_transactions, get_vendors, balance_sheet, cash_flow_statement, and income_statement.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Campfire?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Campfire in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Campfire requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Campfire is developed by Campfire. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
